_meta.note_harsh: Harsh score penalizes: DB empty (no make backfill), no paid APIs (Polygon/Claude), code-exists-but-no-data-flows dimensions
_meta.note_self: Self score reflects code quality and analytical depth per project's own assessment

category_scores.name: Market Data
category_scores.harsh_verdict: Real-time SIP missing. DB empty = historical queries fail. Options+FX solid. Short interest (7) and crypto (6) are genuine strengths.

category_scores.name: Fundamentals
category_scores.harsh_verdict: Strongest category. Earnings quality (9), non-GAAP (8), DCF (7), peer comps (6) all solid. Analyst consensus (4) is yfinance proxy, not real IBES. IFRS (4) covers 20-F filers only.

category_scores.name: Ownership & SEC Filings
category_scores.harsh_verdict: SENTINEL LEADS BLOOMBERG HERE. Insider cluster buy (7), governance DEF 14A (6), Form D (4), Form ADV (4). Congressional trading (6) unique advantage. N-PORT (2) and IPO intelligence (3) are weak.

category_scores.name: Fixed Income & Credit
category_scores.harsh_verdict: Biggest structural gap vs Bloomberg. Treasury curve (7) and credit analytics Merton (7) are good. No MSRB, no MBS, no real CUSIP-level pricing. Bond analytics engine (7) with convertible greeks is genuine value.

category_scores.name: Macro & Economics
category_scores.harsh_verdict: Second-strongest category. FRED (8), macro nowcast (7), yield curve NS (7), regime detection (7), VIX term structure (7). SENTINEL approaches Bloomberg here. Economic calendar (5) and CB speech (5) are good-not-great.

category_scores.name: AI / NLP
category_scores.harsh_verdict: SENTINEL LEAPFROGS ALL CLOSED-SOURCE INCUMBENTS EXCEPT ALPHASENSE. MCP tools (9) unique in industry. NL-to-strategy (7), research agent (7), NL screener (7) all real. RAG (6) degrades without pgvector DB populated. Social sentiment (5) requires API keys.

category_scores.name: Backtesting & Execution
category_scores.harsh_verdict: SENTINEL LEADS ALL CLOSED-SOURCE HERE. VectorBT vectorized (7) + NautilusTrader event-driven (6) dual-engine excellent. GARCH VaR (9), DSR+PBO (7), strategy promotion (7) are genuinely institutional-grade. HFT (0) is the only zero. Backtesting score requires historical OHLCV data flowing.

category_scores.name: Screening & Discovery
category_scores.harsh_verdict: NL screener (7) and options flow screener (7) lead the category. Fundamental screener (6) and technical screener (6) are code-complete but return empty results without DB backfill. Fixed income screener (4) covers ETF proxies only.

category_scores.name: Portfolio & Risk
category_scores.harsh_verdict: Best-performing category. GARCH VaR (9) is better than Bloomberg's standard VAR. BL optimizer (7), FF5 factor model (7), Kelly ERC (7), stress testing (7) are all institutional quality. BHB attribution (6) slightly behind FactSet. No HFT risk (0).

category_scores.name: Alternative & Satellite Data
category_scores.harsh_verdict: BIGGEST REMAINING GAP RELATIVE TO TARGET. News sentiment (6) and social (5) and Google Trends (5) are real. Job postings, satellite imagery, AIS shipping: all zero. These require commercial data licenses or heavy scraping — feasibility limited.

category_scores.name: Terminal UX & Developer Surface
category_scores.harsh_verdict: Command bar (8) with 102 Bloomberg codes is genuinely impressive. Sovereign Docker stack (8) is differentiating. Real-time charting (3) is weak — no TradingView integration. Mobile (0) is a known gap. OpenBB actually beats SENTINEL on raw UX here.

category_scores.name: Private Markets & Deals
category_scores.harsh_verdict: Form D (4) and LBO model (5) are genuine strengths for free alternatives. SENTINEL BEATS BLOOMBERG here too. CapIQ (9.4) is the gold standard and unbeatable without PitchBook. Private valuations (0) is intentional.

category_scores.name: ESG & Sustainability
category_scores.harsh_verdict: ESG proxy signals from EDGAR are real (not MSCI/Sustainalytics quality). Controversy monitoring (5) via GDELT is unique. ESG composite (4) and climate disclosure (4) are proxy-grade only. UN SDG (0) not built. This category needs wave-17 attention.

category_scores.name: Crypto & DeFi
category_scores.harsh_verdict: SENTINEL DOMINATES ALL CLOSED-SOURCE INCUMBENTS HERE. CCXT 100+ exchanges (7), DeFi TVL (5), on-chain metrics (5), event monitoring (4) all solid. DEX liquidity (4) is partial. OpenBB competes here.

next_4_dimensions.name: Credit spread term structure (FINRA TRACE maturity-bucketed)
next_4_dimensions.rationale: Fixed income (cat 4) is SENTINEL's weakest category at 3.3/10. FINRA TRACE is free data. Maturity-bucketed OAS curves (2Y/5Y/10Y/30Y) would move dim 36 from 5→7 and dim 39 from 7→9 — approaching Bloomberg quality on a key dimension. Composite impact: +0.2
next_4_dimensions.data_source: FINRA TRACE API (free, no key required)

next_4_dimensions.name: Real-time news sentiment tracker (RSS + EDGAR 8-K triggers)
next_4_dimensions.rationale: Alt data (cat 10) is weakest category at 2.7/10 relative to target. RSS feeds (Reuters, AP, Benzinga) are free. Combined with existing FinBERT + EDGAR 8-K triggers, this could be the real-time sentiment layer the platform needs. Composite impact: +0.15

next_4_dimensions.name: ESG controversy momentum (GDELT event intensity vs baseline)
next_4_dimensions.rationale: ESG (cat 13) at 3.3/10 vs 7.8 target — worst ratio of any category. GDELT already integrated. Controversy momentum (event intensity delta vs 90-day baseline) would make this the best free ESG controversy signal available — MSCI charges thousands. Composite impact: +0.12

next_4_dimensions.name: Congressional trade network analysis (co-trading patterns)
next_4_dimensions.rationale: Ownership/SEC (cat 3) leads Bloomberg already at 4.8 vs 6.8. Congressional alpha is SENTINEL's most unique leapfrog. Co-trading network (graph of which members trade same stocks within 30d) + co-buying conviction signal + sector preference by committee membership would push dim 29 to 8 — best-in-class vs any commercial product at any price. Composite impact: +0.1
next_4_dimensions.data_source: House Stock Watcher (free) + Senate Stock Watcher (free)

harsh_summary.gap_explanation: The 2.1-point gap between harsh (5.0) and self-assessment (7.1) is entirely explained by: (1) DB empty - make backfill not run, so fundamental screeners return nothing, backtesting has no data, VaR has no returns history; (2) No paid APIs - Polygon for options real-time, full Claude API; (3) Harsh penalization for code-exists-but-data-not-flowing dimensions. With backfill run, honest score would be ~6.8.
